steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy, quick! Make haste and record what I'm about to say! This could be purrhaps the only record of a Rathalos hunt in Terra!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: This is the furst Terra Research Commission! And I am its leader, the Felyne Scholar!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: What's wrong, Smithy? Isn't it natural that I be the leader? Unsatisfied? Mrow! Then you can be the Chief Artisan!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Anyway, enough of that! We stand on the furfront of the hunt... behind a rock on the frontlines!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The ultimate showdown is happening right befur our eyes!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: On one side we have the King of the Skies! On the other we have the local fledgling Terran Hunters, accompanied by a self-purrclaimed battle-hardened Felyne, the Palico!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Though it seems like the Rathalos will win... the current situation is intense beyond imeowgination! Both sides enter the white-hot stage of flames! Are mew writing this all down, Smithy?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: And now we see, the Palico has dodged the Rathalos's attack... Splendid! Its attention has been drawn away!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Seizing the opportunity, Noir Corne rushes towards the Rathalos's tail, and raises his Long Sword! And then!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: And then!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: He's sent flying!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Purrthetic!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne... seems to be fumbling his moves, so let's see how the other is faring. Yato waits for the Rathalos to attack him, and strikes it from the side!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: She cleverly dodges its attack, manages to reach its underside, and aims for her target! The Rathalos's right wing!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: However! It suddenly takes to the air and breathes a huge jet of flame! Her attack has been neutralized, what a pity.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Ah, now Noir Corne is once again attacking the Rathalos! This time he does not miss, and the Long Sword ruthlessly cuts into the Rathalos's tail!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: However... he seems not to have controlled his strength, and was blown away by the Rathalos's tailspin.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: That's twice already...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: But! He stands! The soul of a fighter burns brightly! And he goes in for another round!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I-I'm fine, my chest just feels a little tight *cough*—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Stop looking at me! I'm really fine!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Even as the Rathalos's health dwindles, it becomes ever more difficult to appurroach it.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: The Originium dust surrounding it has increased in density, exponentially increasing the power of its flames, and its attack patterns are becoming hard to predict.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Its acuity has also increased along with its aggressiveness, and it's no longer easily distracted, making it impossible to sneak attacks in.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kisama... We're back to square one—it's difficult to close the distance.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Mrow! The Rathalos isn't facing us anymore!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That direction is...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: It turned towards the temporary shelter, but the villagers are still waiting to be evacuated...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: *Huff*—*huff*—energy into blade, energy as blade...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Noir Corne! Don't get distracted! We have to figure out a way to stop its advance!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Your long sword... even though it's not easy to control the direction of your swings, I should be able to use it as a springboard to approach the Rathalos just like before. This time I'll aim for its weakspot and stop it in its tracks!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: But with the Rathalos enraged, your meowjesty will be completely exposed to its attacks, and will mostly likely have to tackle it head-on...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There's no time! Just go with my plan, Corne!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What? Hurry!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Listen, it took a heavy blow to its skull, and although it looks like it's already recovered from that, its jaw is moving differently now!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We should wait for just the right moment to aim for its head and deal a knock-out blow.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But given the current situation, our odds of getting a good angle are nearly zero.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: If we can manage to knock it down though... that would be a good enough chance, right?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It would, but— Corne! What are you doing?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm going to create that chance! Palico, I'll use that move you told me about! Even though it's real difficult...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Believe in me! Only I can do it!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I believe in you too, Yato! That only you can seize this chance!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Control the blade, and aim for the enemy with your energy to unleash an even stronger power.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Energy as blade, and aim for the enemy...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah! What was it?! That one move...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The one the Palico taught me, similar to the one I was trained in, the most convenient move to chop things with!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty! While the Rathalos is injured, use the Spirit Slash I mentioned!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah, right! Alright, I got it! Next, hold the blade near the waist during the attack!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: And then—unsheathe!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Iai Spirit Slash!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It hit!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty! The time has come!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I remember now! The Long Sword's strongest move! I can feel the call of that power!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Its name is—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hyarrrrggggggghh!!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Spirit Helm Breaker! Hah!
Noir Corne leapt onto the Rathalos, using his momentum to launch himself into the air.
As if pulled by an invisible wire, his body was hurled high up into the sky.
His energy accumulates, condensing into the smallest speck at the highest point.
And then—it bursts.
With a speed meant for thousands of kilometers, he slashes downward at the Rathalos's body.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So much ash...I can't make anything out! Corne! Are you alright?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I... I'm good, but my body kinda doesn't want to move...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: He pulled off the Spirit Helm Breaker in such a short time, how ameowzing!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: But the Rathalos is too perceptive, and made a counterattack.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Make way for meow! Smithy, it's our turn to pull out the cart again! Here we go! Quickly, throw Noir Corne on top!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy, what are you doing? That's not Noir Corne!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: That is...mrow!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: The Rathalos's tail! He chopped it off! It's fallen!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: This is your best chance!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No time for hesitation... I'm moving in.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Ahh—quick, bring Noir Corne away! Don't interfur with my note-taking!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm leaving the rest to you, Yato.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (The wound... where is it? Somewhere in the lower jaw...)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Curses, there's so much dust swirling around, visibility is so poor...)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Found it! There!)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll finish you off here!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty! Purrlease stop!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ngh—Damn it! I lost the perfect chance!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: To actually recover so quickly even with its tail cut off, this Rathalos is truly incredible.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: It's about to take flight! The direction... it seems it's still heading toward the temporary shelter!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Is there no way to knock it down? There must be, right? Palico?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty, the only thing that could work now would be a Flash Bomb, but mine broke befur I came here.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: With our current resources, we have no way of fighting it if it doesn't come down to attack us.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Then are we going to just stand and watch it destroy everything? Waste all of our efforts?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No... it can't end like this!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: The most important lesson from the Hunters who've fought these monsters throughout the ages with their own flesh and blood is that we must drag them into our hunting grounds to be able to compete with these creatures beyond imagination.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: The Rathalos is the King of the Skies, so the sky is its territory...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: There... might be no way to stop one like this.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Hey! Smithy! Don't go over there, it's dangerous!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: One tool that works just like a Flash Bomb, right here fur mew!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What are you saying...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Mew managed to craft one?

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: It's beclaws of this.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: I found some local Originium slugs in the stinky fowls' nest earlier that can emit a purrdy strong light!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: I mixed some other meowterials in and bang! Crafted a Flash Bomb kind of tool!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty! This is the ultimate weapon against a Rathalos!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Throw it at its head and it will explode with a blinding light. Remeowmber to shield your eyes!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's like throwing a grenade, right? I got it.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mew can call it the Shiny Flash 'nade!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Pass it to me!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Aiming)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Fall!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Mew did it! The Rathalos has fallen out of the sky!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Palico, what's the most... effective move to use on the Rathalos with these Dual Blades I'm using?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: The Midair Spinning Blade Dance! Mew must first enter Demon Mode, and then jump in the direction you want to attack...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Skip to the important part!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Spin your Dual Blades in the most violent way and dance through the air!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Blade dance...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (An opening... I need to find one...)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A mid-air blade dance...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Eat meow blade!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Rathalos!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm here!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm your opponent!
She rushed straight in, with nothing but her quarry in her eyes.
The dual blades spun and twirled in the air, slicing through the smoke and dust.
Her body whirled through the air, as if dancing.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: We managed to tie it up! It is fortunate I learnt a meowthod of binding monsters in an eastern village...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Did we do it?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Finally... victory.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty, it will be difficult to keep it trapped for too long, so mew must decide what to do posthaste!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I... I know.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Previously, I had thought the Rathalos should not be your target, but after having hunted side-by-side with mew, I have changed my mind.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: I did not understand this great land of yours and the existence of Originium, so I cannot be sure of what other threats the Rathalos may pose in the future.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: This is your home, so the decision should be left to mew.
Her gaze swept over the massive body as ashes scattered everywhere from its struggle.
Even though its scales were riddled with scars, its might was still daunting.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What truly impressive vitality...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: For the safety of everyone that comes after, I must ensure the threat is eradicated. For that is my duty.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Let's finish it off.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato! Wait!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: *cough* Listen to me, there's no need...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No need to what?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: *cough* I'm choking so bad... there's no need for us to end its life.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And your reasoning is?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Because...*cough*

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Let meow explain!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Look at the pawrts with the Originium clusters.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy, hand meow the hammer, we will conduct some tapping!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It fell off?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne, take this and go test it fur active Originium.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I learnt from the other scholar that the Rathalos's violent tempawrament was a side effect of the Originium's influence, but it's not actually infected, even though it was spreading Originium dust everywhere.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: This may not be enough to dispel your doubts, but... I also discovered something very interesting deep in the mine and compawed it with my notes, and have confurmed the following...

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: In truth, the Rathalos has been fighting against the Originium's influence, and the clusters are a pawduct of its resistance.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Noir Corne, the test results confurm my hypawthesis, yes?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yeah, these Originium clusters aren't active.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: The Rathalos is merely contaminated with active Originium from the area, and as long as it's not in an active Originium zone, will spread no dust on its own.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But we can't guarantee that it won't appear next to an Originium mine in the future, so it's still dangerous. Or do I have to find a way to transport it somewhere and keep it locked up?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: No... I purr-omise you it won't fly too far from here.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: It's already old, and starvation has worn it out. And after this hunt... it's meowbility is extremely poor now.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: I think it went to the Originium mine to try and recover its strength, fur their nests resemble the volcanic area we saw deep inside.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Indeed, I recall seeing it head towards a volcano when I furst spotted it.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: And now that I think on it, it must be trying to return from whence it came... Mrow.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne... what do you think?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I think... since it no longer poses a threat, and since it didn't attack anyone deliberately...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The Rathalos...
The Rathalos was panting violently, fiery sparks splashing out of its jaws and over its new scars.
Its body was still trembling nonstop, squeezing out the very last of its breath, desperately fighting against its shackles.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: That scared the meow out of me! Mew are all tied up and still moving around!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The Catastrophe...is coming closer and closer.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...In the face of a real disaster, we are truly insigniﬁcant.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Palico, you're wrong about one thing.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: This land has never belonged to us alone, but also to all the life here that's just trying to survive.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Fighting each other for the chance to live, even if...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: They die bravely in the process.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, where are you going?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Reinforcements are almost here, so I'll head to the shelter and help the villagers evacuate.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What about the Rathalos?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I don't waste time on anything unrelated to my mission, since there will always be some other meddler ready to sort things out.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Captain's log number five, this is Rhodes Island Operations Team A4...Captain Yato.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The source of the Originium dust spreading in Roka Village has been dealt with, and the threat has been eliminated. The next step is to complete the evacuation and ensure the villagers are safe from the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Mission complete, end of recording.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Hurry, lady! The monster is flying away!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Huh? The Rathalos flew away?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Hah, I expected as much.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Is it because those people couldn't defeat it? Were they not strong enough?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: No, they're truly strong. They defeated a whole bunch of Originium slugs, after all.

steps.name: Kazuya
steps.text: Are Originium slugs the same level as that monster...?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: They definitely made the right choice.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: It flew away... my moneymaker has flown away...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Get in the car, now. We have yet to settle our accounts.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: (Wiping knife)

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Akira, you would have done it this way as well, wouldn't you?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I knew you saved a arma-clawbeast cub back then...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It flew away.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: It really flew away.

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Flew away!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What are you guys dallying about for? Come over and help!
